physical_argument.mechanism: Gravitational redshift scales with compactness: z_grav = GM/(rc^2) ∝ Σ × r
physical_argument.degeneracy: At JWST broadband resolution (R~5), z_grav mimics dust reddening and old stellar age
physical_argument.consequence: SED fitting systematically overestimates M* for compact sources by factor ~1.5-3×
physical_argument.combined_with_pseudo_photosphere: Total overestimation factor ~3-10× for most extreme sources
physical_argument.testable_prediction: High-R spectroscopy (R>3000) will show z_em > z_abs by Δz ~ 10^-3 to 10^-2
resolves: Missing dust problem (high BD, low AV)
